in_hebrew.name: Bazluke
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Bold, warrior name
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bazluke הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Hebrew Baal, meaning 'lord' or 'master'. The suffix '-luke' may indicate 'fighter' or 'strong one'. In the Bible, Baal was the name of various pagan deities and was worshiped through the burning of sacrifices. This name would be a reminder of God's ultimate power over all false gods and idols.
